confidence_intervals.method: 95% percentile bootstrap resampling whole speaker/session groups

paired_tests.method: Two-sided paired randomization with model labels swapped by speaker/session group
paired_tests.p_value_correction: Plus-one Monte Carlo correction, then Holm across 12 comparisons
paired_tests.difference_direction: Model A minus model B, in percentage points

caveat: The published Icelandic wav2vec 2.0 and Whisper Small checkpoints may have seen some Samrómur test clips during external training.
